import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class A819_v1 {
    static int countDistinct(int[] colors, int left, int right) {
        boolean[] seen = new boolean[24];
        int distinct = 0;
        for (int i = left; i <= right; i++) {
            int color = colors[i];
            if (!seen[color]) {
                seen[color] = true;
                distinct++;
            }
        }
        return distinct;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int l = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
        int r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
        int total = a + b;
        int cycles = 4;
        int[] pattern = new int[total * cycles];
        int offset = l / total;
        l -= offset * total;
        r -= offset * total;
        int span = (r - l + 1) / total;
        if (span > 2) {
            r -= (span - 2) * total;
        }
        int diff = a > b ? a - b : 1;

        // Build base pattern
        for (int c = 0; c < cycles; c++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < a - diff; k++) {
                pattern[total * c + k] = k;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < diff; k++) {
                pattern[total * c + a - diff + k] = (c % 2 == 0) ? (a - diff + k) : (a + k);
            }
        }

        int best = a + a;
        for (int i1 = 1; i1 <= diff; i1++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < b; j++) {
                pattern[total * 0 + a + j] = pattern[total * 0 + a - i1];
            }
            for (int i2 = 1; i2 <= diff; i2++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < b; j++) {
                    pattern[total * 1 + a + j] = pattern[total * 1 + a - i2];
                }
                for (int i3 = 1; i3 <= diff; i3++) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < b; j++) {
                        pattern[total * 2 + a + j] = pattern[total * 2 + a - i3];
                    }
                    for (int i4 = 1; i4 <= diff; i4++) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < b; j++) {
                            pattern[total * 3 + a + j] = pattern[total * 3 + a - i4];
                        }
                        best = Math.min(best, countDistinct(pattern, l, r));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(best);
    }
}
